operations.label: The mixture is heated to 120 °C under gentle stirring and degassed for 1 h under vacuum.
operations.description: The mixture is heated to 120 °C under gentle stirring and degassed for 1 h under vacuum.

operations.label: The mixture is purged with Ar gas and heated to 180 °C for 30 min.
operations.description: The mixture is purged with Ar gas and heated to 180 °C for 30 min.

operations.label: P(DMA)3 is rapidly injected into the mixture and reacted at 180 °C for 30 min.
operations.description: P(DMA)3 is rapidly injected into the mixture and reacted at 180 °C for 30 min.

operations.label: Se stock solution is slowly injected to the mixture and reacted at 200 °C for 30 min.
operations.description: Se stock solution is slowly injected to the mixture and reacted at 200 °C for 30 min.

operations.label: Zn stock solution is slowly injected to the mixture and reacted at 220 °C for 30 min.
operations.description: Zn stock solution is slowly injected to the mixture and reacted at 220 °C for 30 min.

operations.label: Se-S stock solution is slowly added to the mixture at 240 °C and maintained for 30 min.
operations.description: Se-S stock solution is slowly added to the mixture at 240 °C and maintained for 30 min.

operations.label: Zn stock solution is injected slowly at 260 °C and maintained for 30 min.
operations.description: Zn stock solution is injected slowly at 260 °C and maintained for 30 min.

operations.label: S-rich stock solution is injected slowly at 280 °C and maintained at that temperature for 30 min.
operations.description: S-rich stock solution is injected slowly at 280 °C and maintained at that temperature for 30 min.

operations.label: 1-DDT is slowly injected and reacted at 200 °C for 60 min.
operations.description: 1-DDT is slowly injected and reacted at 200 °C for 60 min.

operations.label: Zinc oleate is added to the mixture and reacted at 190 °C for 120 min.
operations.description: Zinc oleate is added to the mixture and reacted at 190 °C for 120 min.

operations.label: The mixture is washed by centrifugation using ethanol/hexane mixture.
operations.description: The mixture is washed by centrifugation using ethanol/hexane mixture.

operations.label: The synthesized QDs are dispersed in chloroform and stored in a refrigerator.
operations.description: The synthesized QDs are dispersed in chloroform and stored in a refrigerator.

notes: Reactor: 50 mL three-neck flask (Main PDF p.2).
